Hermes template home <scratch>/w-6f4f5eb709f8bd63/a: config.yaml `delegation.subagent_auto_approve: true` (children run shell commands unprompted, as `--yolo` lets the parent) and `delegation.oneshot_max_children: 0` (unlimited: Hermes lets a one-shot session such as `hermes chat --oneshot` start only 2 subagents by default, then refuses `delegate_task` and tells the model to review its own work inline; interactive and messaging-gateway sessions have no such cap; the eval lifts it so a full run can delegate as on the other harnesses). Children cannot start children (Hermes's `max_spawn_depth` 1). .env linked to ~/.hermes/.env; installs/ (the Python dependency environment Hermes builds per home) built once. Each session gets a fresh home `<run>/h` (HERMES_HOME) holding that config, the linked .env, and installs/ linked; a session starts only while installs/ is unchanged since it was built (a check against accidents, not a guarantee: the gateway runs Hermes's own source tree, which is not checked). No user config, memory, SOUL.md, skills, plugins, or prior sessions; a fresh home holds Hermes's own default SOUL.md, bundled skills, and bundled plugins. The project AGENTS.md loads in its system prompt (no `--ignore-rules`). The Hermes agent runs in a gateway daemon that `hermes chat` starts for that home, whose working directory is Hermes's source tree, not the task directory; its shell and file tools act in the task directory (`--in`). The driver kills the daemon's process group after every session, and the runner's sweep kills anything else whose HERMES_HOME is under the run directory. duration_s includes the daemon's start, seconds before the turn begins, so it is longer than the same turn on another harness. Shell commands an `execute_code` script runs through its `terminal()` are not seen: they are not in shell_commands, files opened, or the ritual steps. A child's task, for handoff_exact, is its goal plus the context Hermes puts in its system prompt; Hermes's tool description asks for that context, so a weak model may add it where another harness's would not. Thinking: `--thinking` passes as `--reasoning` (off as none) and children inherit it; each session's effective setting is recorded from its transcript, on or off. cost_usd: null, since Hermes prices DeepSeek at its off-peak rates in every hour (peak hours cost twice that); its figure is kept as harness_reported_cost_usd. Every value of a key, token, secret, password, access, or refresh entry of the linked .env (8 characters or more) is replaced by [redacted] in the session files and run records the results keep.
